name: Saakshi Medtech & Panels Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, Saakshi Medtech 
& Panels Ltd deals in Electrical Control 
 Panels, Medical X-Ray Systems, 
 Fabrication & Wire Harness[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SMPL is engaged in manufacturing Electrical Control Panels & Cabinets, Medical X-Ray Systems, Fabrication & Wire Harness. It caters to OEM’s in various segments like Oil & Gas, Aviation, Renewables, Healthcare, Locomotives, etc.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 8.57% over past five years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Debtor days have increased from 69.0 to 86.4 days.
Working capital days have increased from 84.2 days to 129 days
